लोल, अस्, आ, अम्, moving hither and thither, shak-
ing, rolling, tossing, swinging about, dangling, pen-
dent, tremulous, trembling, quivering, agitated,
alarmed, unsteady, restless, uneasy; changeable, in-
constant, fickle; desiring, desirous, coveting, long-
ing for, eager or anxious for, greedy, lustful; (अस्),
m. a proper N.; (आ), f. the tongue; lightning;
the goddess of fortune or Lakṣmī (as ‘the fickle or
changeable one’); N. of Dākṣāyaṇī in Utpalāvar-
taka; of the mother of the Daitya Madhu; of a
female personification in Hindū music; of a metre,
four times twenty-four instants [cf. रोला]; of another,
four times ¯¯¯˘˘¯¯, ¯¯¯˘˘¯¯.
—लोल-
[]
कुण्डल, अस्, आ, अम्, having dangling or pendent
ear-rings.
—लोल-घट (?) , the wind.
—लोल-जिह्व,
अस्, आ, अम्, having a rolling or restless tongue, in-
satiable, greedy.
—लोल-ता, f. or लोल-त्व, अम्, n.
movableness, tremulousness, fickleness, unsteadiness,
restlessness; eager desire for, cupidity, lustfulness,
lust.
—लोल-लोल, अस्, आ, अम्, being in constant
motion, continually moving, ever restless.
—लोलाक्षि
(˚ल-अक्˚), इस्, इस्, इ, having a rolling eye.
—लोला-
क्षिका, f. (a woman) with a rolling eye.
—लोला-
पाङ्ग (˚ल-अप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having tremulous or
quivering outer corners (said of the eyes).
—लोलार्क
(˚ल-अर्˚), अस्, m. a form of the sun.

लोलत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, moving to and fro, rolling,
tossing about.
—लोलद्-भुज, अस्, आ, अम्, having
swinging arms.
लोलन, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.

लोलमान, अस्, आ, अम्, rolling, tossing, rolling on
the ground.

लोलित, अस्, आ, अम्, moved hither and thither,
waved to and fro, shaken, agitated, tremulous, trem-
bling; [cf. लोडित.]

लोलुव, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Intens.), cutting much
or often.
लोलुव लोलुव, लोलूया. See p. 871, col. 1.

लोलूया, f. determination to cut.
—लोलूया-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, resolved to cut or cut off.

लोलिका लोलिका, f. a sort of sorrel, Oxalis
Pusilla, (according to some Rumex Vesicarius.)

लोलिम्बराज लोलिम्ब-राज, अस्, m., N. of
the author of the Vaidya-jīvana.

लोलुप लोलुप, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Intens.
of rt. 1. लुप्), very destructive, destroying; very de-
sirous, very eager, ardently longing for, covetous, (in
these senses a corruption of लोलुभ below); (आ), f.
eager desire, appetite, longing, eagerness.
—लोलुप-
ता, f. or लोलुप-त्व, अम्, n. eager desire or longing;
greediness, cupidity, desire, lust, lustfulness.

लोलुभ लोलुभ, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Intens.
of rt. लुभ्), very desirous, eagerly longing for or
coveting, ardently wishing for, greedy after.
लोलोर लोलोर, अम्, n., N. of a town.
लोल्लट लोल्लट, अस्, m., N. of an author.
